523:         return null;

10: const PROJECT_DIR_LENGTH_CAP = 200;
11: export async function claudeProjectDir(cwd, options) {
12:     const canonical = await canonicalize(cwd);
13:     const projectsRoot = join(resolveConfigDir(options), "projects");
14:     return join(projectsRoot, encode(canonical));
15: }
16: export function claudeProjectDirSync(cwd, options) {
17:     const canonical = canonicalizeSync(cwd);
18:     const projectsRoot = join(resolveConfigDir(options), "projects");
19:     return join(projectsRoot, encode(canonical));
20: }
21: async function canonicalize(input) {
39: }
40: function encode(input) {
41:     const replaced = input.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "-");
42:     if (replaced.length <= PROJECT_DIR_LENGTH_CAP) {
43:         return replaced;
44:     }
45:     return `${replaced.slice(0, PROJECT_DIR_LENGTH_CAP)}-${hashSuffix(input)}`;
46: }
47: function hashSuffix(input) {
48:     let hash = 0;
49:     for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
50:         hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + input.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
51:     }
52:     return Math.abs(hash).toString(36);
53: }
54: function resolveConfigDir(options) {
55:     return options?.configDir ?? process.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR ?? join(homedir(), ".claude");
56: }

59: // Filenames are a content hash of the bytes so re-materializing the same image
60: // within a process reuses the existing temp file instead of leaking a fresh one
61: // for repeated image blocks or history replay.
62: export function materializeProviderImage(image) {
63:     const attachmentsDir = getMaterializedImageAttachmentDir();
64:     const normalized = normalizeImageData(image.mimeType ?? "image/png", image.data);
65:     const bytes = Buffer.from(normalized.data, "base64");
66:     const extension = getImageExtension(normalized.mimeType);
67:     const hash = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
68:     const filePath = path.join(attachmentsDir, `${hash}.${extension}`);
69:     fsSync.writeFileSync(filePath, bytes, { mode: MATERIALIZED_IMAGE_FILE_MODE });
70:     fsSync.chmodSync(filePath, MATERIALIZED_IMAGE_FILE_MODE);
71:     return { path: filePath };
72: }
73: // Recognizes markdown rendered for a materialized provider image: its source is a content-hashed
74: // file in the attachments dir. Matching the full <hash>.<ext> shape (not just a leading "![")
75: // keeps user-authored text from being mistaken for a provider image during history replay. The
76: // separator still accepts old doubled-backslash Windows history; new Windows output uses file URIs.

78: export function isProviderImageMarkdown(text) {
79:     return PROVIDER_IMAGE_MARKDOWN.test(text);

150:   /// The folder on the phone that holds Ubuntu's [path] (for reading it with
151:   /// dart:io), or null when it is missing, not a real folder, or Ubuntu's
152:   /// files are not there. Never follows a link.
153:   Future<String?> hostDirectory(String path) async {
154:     final ubuntuPath = normalize(path);
155:     if (ubuntuPath == null) return null;
156:     try {
157:       final projects = await _locateProjects();
158:       final external = projects == null
159:           ? null
160:           : await _hostPath(projects.path, '/');
161:       const projectsPath = BuiltinLinux.projectsDir;
162:       if (external != null &&
163:           (ubuntuPath == projectsPath ||
164:               ubuntuPath.startsWith('$projectsPath/'))) {
165:         return await _hostPath(
166:           external,
167:           ubuntuPath.substring(projectsPath.length),
168:         );
169:       }
170:       final rootfs = await _locate();
171:       return rootfs == null ? null : await _hostPath(rootfs.path, ubuntuPath);
172:     } on FolderListException {
173:       return null;
174:     } on FileSystemException {
175:       return null;
176:     }
177:   }
261:   /// The phone path of [ubuntuPath], checking every folder on the way is a
262:   /// real folder (not a link). Null when a part of it is missing.
263:   static Future<String?> _hostPath(String rootfs, String ubuntuPath) async {
264:     var host = rootfs;
265:     final segments = ubuntuPath.split('/').where((s) => s.isNotEmpty);
266:     for (final segment in ['', ...segments]) {
267:       if (segment.isNotEmpty) host = '$host/$segment';
268:       final type = await FileSystemEntity.type(host, followLinks: false);
269:       if (type == FileSystemEntityType.notFound) return null;
270:       if (type == FileSystemEntityType.link) {
271:         throw FolderListException(FolderListProblem.linked, ubuntuPath);
272:       }
273:       if (type != FileSystemEntityType.directory) {
274:         throw FolderListException(FolderListProblem.missing, ubuntuPath);
275:       }
276:     }
277:     return host;
278:   }
